body.purpose: Paragraph copy, always in Muted Ink.

label.purpose: Section labels and index badges, mono, always Beacon Blue.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Stat cards, terminal panel, standard lifted surfaces.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: Hover states, the contact form panel.

shadows.name: shadow-glow
shadows.purpose: Paired with shadow-md/lg on anything that should read as live.

motion.name: reveal-ease
motion.purpose: Scroll-reveal translate+fade entrance, 0.7s, staggered ~80ms per sibling.

motion.name: hover-ease
motion.purpose: Standard 0.25s hover transition for lift, border-color, background.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action pill button; navy-to-signal-blue gradient with dual shadow + glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.9rem 1.75rem; border-radius: 999px; border: none; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, hsl(217 68% 20%), hsl(224 76% 53%)); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px hsl(222 47% 8% / 0.10), 0 2px 8px hsl(222 47% 8% / 0.06), 0 0 40px hsl(224 76% 53% / 0.14); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, filter 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); filter: brightness(1.08); box-shadow: 0 24px 56px hsl(222 47% 8% / 0.14), 0 6px 16px hsl(222 47% 8% / 0.07), 0 0 40px hsl(224 76% 53% / 0.14); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(224 76% 53%); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary pill button; translucent glass surface with hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.9rem 1.75rem; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; color: hsl(222 47% 8%); border: 1px solid hsl(220 16% 88%); background: hsl(0 0% 100% / 0.4); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.25s ease, background-color 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: hsl(224 76% 53% / 0.5); background: hsl(224 76% 53% / 0.08); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(224 76% 53%); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Numeric stat tile used in hero and about-page stat grids.
components.css: .ds-stat-card { background: hsl(0 0% 100%); border: 1px solid hsl(220 16% 88%); border-radius: 10px; padding: 32px; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px hsl(222 47% 8% / 0.10), 0 2px 8px hsl(222 47% 8% / 0.06), 0 0 50px hsl(217 68% 20% / 0.12); transition: transform 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease; } .ds-stat-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); border-color: hsl(224 76% 53% / 0.4); box-shadow: 0 24px 56px hsl(222 47% 8% / 0.14), 0 6px 16px hsl(222 47% 8% / 0.07); } .ds-stat-value { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 2.6rem; color: hsl(217 68% 20%); margin: 0 0 10px; } .ds-stat-label { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; color: hsl(220 9% 40%); margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field used in the staged contact form.
components.html: <label class="ds-label">Business name<input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Company name"></label>
components.css: .ds-label { display: grid; gap: 10px; color: hsl(222 47% 8%); font-weight: 700; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: hsl(0 0% 100%); color: hsl(222 47% 8%); border: 1px solid hsl(220 16% 88%); border-radius: 10px; padding: 15px 16px; font: inherit; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: hsl(224 76% 53%); }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: Mono uppercase eyebrow label preceding every major section heading.
components.css: .ds-section-label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6em; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: hsl(224 76% 53%); } .ds-section-label::before { content: ''; width: 0.9em; height: 1px; background: hsl(224 76% 53% / 0.6); }

components.name: Index Badge
components.description: Numbered mono badge used to index feature/info cards (01, 02...).
components.css: .ds-index-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 2.6rem; height: 1.75rem; padding: 0 0.5rem; border: 1px solid hsl(224 76% 53% / 0.35); border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: hsl(224 76% 53%); background: hsl(224 76% 53% / 0.06); }

components.name: Info Card
components.description: Indexed feature card used in 'Why Us' style grids.

Fit over convenience

narrative.overview:
Indomisa reads like the desk of a precision engineer working late: a deep navy field, one signal-blue instrument light left on, and everything else deliberately quiet so that light means something. The site is B2B software engineering communicated visually — not a marketing stunt, not a generic gradient template. Copy stays plain and confident ("Stop forcing your business into generic tools"); the interface backs that up with instrumentation cues instead of decoration: a live terminal typing itself out in the hero, corner-bracket "viewfinder" frames on a handful of key panels, monospace index badges and section labels, and a starfield/particle backdrop that reads as ambient telemetry rather than a hero graphic.

Within that calm field, the system is tactile and alive rather than static: cards lift on hover, borders warm to signal-blue, dual-layer shadows (a dark structural offset plus an accent glow) make glass surfaces feel genuinely lifted, and backdrop-blur is used generously so panels feel like physical glass over the starfield, not flat rectangles. The result should feel engineered and awake, never playful or soft. Explicitly rejected: the generic SaaS purple/pink-gradient template look — no purple, no blob shapes, no neon haze. Indomisa's only glow is navy-to-signal-blue, and it appears because something is active (a button, a stat, a live cursor), not as ambient decoration.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color (Beacon Blue) carries all "this is active/important" signaling — pulses, links, focus rings, hover borders, glow.
Instrumentation motifs (terminal, viewfinder brackets, mono labels, index badges) are a signature, used sparingly on a few key panels, not everywhere.
Every surface responds to hover or focus — lift, border-warm, or glow — so nothing on the page reads as inert.
Full light/dark parity: every token is a CSS custom property that flips under .dark, re-tuned for contrast rather than simply darkened.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Beacon Blue is the only color allowed to mean "active" — pulses, focus, hover, links, glow. If a second hue starts carrying meaning, the system has drifted.

rules.name: The Themed-Pair Rule
rules.body: Every color ships as a light/dark pair tuned independently for contrast (dark mode is not light mode with inverted lightness). A new color token is incomplete without both.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-System Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono is reserved for things that look machine-generated or instrumentation-like (labels, badges, the terminal, stat captions) — never for prose.

rules.name: The Lift-On-Hover Rule
rules.body: Cards and buttons don't just brighten on hover — they physically translate up (2–6px) while their shadow deepens. A hover that only changes color is under-built for this system.

dos: Do keep Beacon Blue as the only color that signals "active" (links, focus, hover borders, glow, the hero pulse dot).
Do pair every new surface with a hover response — lift, border-warm, or glow — consistent with the Lift-On-Hover Rule.
Do use the 5-step radius scale (8/10/14/18/24px) and full-pill (999px) for anything clickable; never hardcode an arbitrary radius.
Do reserve IBM Plex Mono for system/instrumentation text (labels, badges, terminal, stat captions).
Do define every new color as a light/dark pair in styles.scss, tuned independently for contrast.
donts: Don't introduce a third brand hue (purple, teal, etc.) — the system is strictly navy + signal-blue + neutrals.
Don't reach for the generic SaaS purple/pink gradient or blob-shape aesthetic; Indomisa's only glow is the navy-to-accent gradient, motivated by "this is active," not decoration.
Don't apply the .ix-frame corner-bracket treatment broadly — it marks a small number of signature "instrument" panels, and loses meaning if it becomes a generic card decoration.
Don't fabricate testimonials, client logos, or case-study results in component examples — no real ones exist yet; placeholder content must read as illustrative.
Don't use Space Grotesk or mono for long-form body copy; body text stays in IBM Plex Sans at Muted Ink.
